name: What affects the cost of handyman repair tasks the most?

mainEntity.name: What affects the cost of handyman repair tasks the most?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on labor time, parts, and the complexity of the repair. Small jobs are often the most cost-effective when you bundle several punch-list items together, because one visit can handle multiple fixes instead of charging separately for each trip.
acceptedAnswer.description: The biggest cost drivers are labor time, parts, and whether you can combine several small repairs into one visit.
